comment: Outstanding trip planned from Chennai. The Alleppey private houseboat was the highlight of our vacation. Food was delicious and authentic Kerala style.
Booking direct flight from Chennai to Singapore through Lyan Travels was seamless. Universal Studios and Gardens by the Bay tickets were all pre-booked with zero waiting!
Departing from Trichy airport was so convenient. 55 minutes flight and we were in Colombo! The driver cum guide spoke fluent Tamil and made our family feel very safe.
